verdict.rationale: Zero is an AI email client, and scheduling recurring jobs or workflows is a fair question for that kind of product. The evidence pack documents only one-off MCP actions such as sending, drafting, labeling, and bulk archiving, plus AI composition and chat-with-inbox features. Nothing shows a recurring schedule, cron-style trigger, or scheduled workflow.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
